note: Redistributable natural-speech corpus for T2-v2 (experiment: real human speech vs the SAPI TTS ceiling of T2). Audio licenses are per-file as recorded; transcripts are public-domain texts fetched verbatim from the listed Wikisource pages (transcriptNotes records orthographic-only modernizations where the spoken word is identical).

clips.transcriptNotes: de.wikisource transcription verbatim; orthographic-only fix where spoken identical: source-print 'Jenun' -> 'Je nun'. Reference INCLUDES the reader's spoken opening announcement, which follows the documented de.wikisource 'Gesprochene Wikisource' formula (https://de.wikisource.org/wiki/Wikisource:Gesprochene_Wikisource).

annotation.rationale: clip is one complete poem read start to finish; the RIFF/ffprobe-measured duration is the true span of that single utterance, so [0, duration] is a real temporal annotation (no file-duration-vs-multi-sentence-span confound)
